label: Days above threshold
blurb: The mean number of days a year on which the daily maximum air temperature reaches the air threshold, across the species' range.
method: Every cell of the species' Calflora range is included, whether or not the species has been recorded there. Each range cell (H3 resolution 8) takes the value of the LOCA2 cell (resolution 7) that contains it. The air threshold is the leaf threshold minus the leaf-to-air offset; a day counts when its maximum air temperature is at or above it. Values are mean days a year over the 30-year period, averaged across three climate models. Both settings are whole degrees, so the threshold always falls on the table's 0.5 °C grid and needs no interpolation. Means and shares are weighted by area over the range cells inside the LOCA2 domain, which ends near 29.6°N, so a few range cells in Baja California are left out; numerator and denominator always use the same cells.
